policies.title: Named ordinary passports: visa-free entry for up to 30 days
policies.summary: The current MFA schedule directly grants these ordinary passport nationalities visa-free entry, generally for up to 30 days, under listed unilateral resolutions or agreements.
conditions: The cited MFA table is passport-type-specific. This policy includes only rows that expressly cover ordinary, regular, unspecified 'without a visa', or all foreign passports; diplomatic, service, official and special-only rows are excluded.

The table gives 30 days for this group, except that Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Moldova, Russia and Ukraine are separately recorded with their agreement-specific terms.

Foreign citizens with a standard visa or visa-free status must register with the stated internal-affairs or foreign-affairs bodies within the stated period, subject to agreement exceptions. Passport validity, return/onward travel, funds, purpose, port, extension, health, security and individual-admissibility requirements remain applicable.

This is short visitor-entry evidence only. It does not decide work, residence, business, transit, GBAO permits, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, border-crossing or case-specific admission rules.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: visa-free entry under agreement-specific terms
policies.summary: The MFA table directly records these ordinary passport visa exemptions with a 90-day term or an agreement-specific stay arrangement rather than the unilateral 30-day cohort.
conditions: The MFA schedule records Armenia, Azerbaijan and Ukraine up to 90 days; the CIS agreement rows for Belarus, Georgia, Moldova and Russia do not state a day limit; Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan cite bilateral movement/stay agreements.

Do not substitute a generic 30-day limit for the cited agreement terms. Registration and all applicable admission, security, purpose, residence, work, transit, border-route and document conditions remain applicable.
This finding is limited to ordinary passports and does not decide diplomatic, service, official, special-document or individual waiver treatment.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: visa-free entry only for travellers over 55
policies.summary: Government Resolution No. 190, as reflected in the current MFA schedule, grants these ordinary passport holders visa-free entry for up to 14 days only where the traveller is over 55 years old.
conditions: The exemption is conditional on the holder being over 55 years old and is limited to up to 14 days. It is not a general nationality-wide ordinary-passport waiver for younger travellers.
Registration, passport validity, visit purpose, port, onward travel, funds, extension, security and individual-admissibility requirements remain applicable.
Does not decide diplomatic, service, official, special-document, residence, work, business, transit or GBAO-permit treatment.

policies.title: Moroccan ordinary passports: visa-free entry for up to 14 days
policies.summary: The current MFA schedule directly gives ordinary Moroccan passports visa-free entry for up to 14 days under Government Resolution No. 190.
conditions: The table separately gives diplomatic and service passport treatment; this policy is confined to the express ordinary-foreign-passport, 14-day row.
Registration, passport validity, purpose, ports, onward travel, funds, extension, security and individual-admissibility requirements remain applicable.
Does not decide residence, work, business, transit, GBAO, diplomatic, service, official or special-document treatment.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: advance eVisa available in the live selector
policies.summary: The official eImmigration service's live CountryForEVisa selector directly includes these passport nationalities. Easier visa-free routes in the MFA schedule are modeled separately and take precedence.
conditions: This classification rests on the live field explicitly named CountryForEVisa in the official eVisa application catalog, not merely on an online form. It is an advance application route, not a visa-on-arrival finding.

The MFA PDF says its simplified visa/eVisa requests are fee-based and may also describe visa-support confirmation or official-invitation routes. Follow the current application workflow, fees, passport, photograph, duration, entry, port and decision requirements presented during application.

The selector has a stateless-person record that is not a nationality passport code and is deliberately excluded. Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan are modeled only as the portal's named passport/nationality records, not as an inference about PRC travel documents or residence status.

Does not decide visa on arrival with support confirmation, GBAO permits, residence, work, business, transit, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, security or individual-admissibility treatment.

application.label: Tajikistan e-Visa application
steps: Select the eVisa application route in the official Tajikistan eImmigration service.
Choose the passport nationality shown in the live CountryForEVisa selector.
Submit the application and required documents, pay the applicable fee, and await the official decision before travel.

policies.title: Other foreign ordinary passports: advance consular visa required
policies.summary: After its current named visa-free and simplified/eVisa cohorts, the MFA PDF expressly says citizens of all other countries must obtain a visa from Tajik embassies or consulates before departure.
conditions: This is an explicit official default for other foreign countries, not an inference from their absence in an eVisa list. Obtain the visa from a Tajik embassy or consulate before departure.

The classification does not collapse the separate support-confirmation/official-invitation simplified arrival process into a nationality-wide visa on arrival. It also does not claim that online submission converts a consular visa into eVisa issuance.
Registration, passport validity, purpose, duration, entries, port, fee, supporting documents, extension, onward travel, funds, security and individual-admissibility requirements remain applicable.
Does not decide GBAO permits, residence, work, business, transit, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, stateless-person, PRC travel-document or route-specific treatment.

policies.title: Tajikistan: citizenship entry
policies.summary: Tajikistan's Constitution gives a citizen the right to travel, leave the Republic and return, supporting the same-country citizenship classification.
conditions: This is a citizenship/right-of-return finding, not foreign visitor-visa evidence.
It does not decide documentary requirements, dual nationality, residence, GBAO access, exit control, security, criminal-law or individual-admissibility issues.
